description: Look up one MCP server, or one package, in the local agentgate evidence index. Use this when you know what you are asking about and want its record: the verdict, the coverage block (which scanners ran, which did not, and why), and the findings. Do not use it to check a list of tools you use; inventory_tools answers that question and returns one line per tool instead. A record that is incomplete is reported as incomplete, never as clean.

server.description: Registry server name, for example org.example/tools

version.description: Exact version, to narrow a package match

name: lookup_server

found.description: false means this index has no such record; it is not a statement that the tool is safe or that it does not exist

indexWarning.description: Present only when the server was started with a note about the index it loaded.

query.description: present when found is false, echoing what was asked

record.description: One index record, reduced to what a reader can act on.

coverage.description: null when the record was written before records carried a coverage block

verdict.description: clean, findings, incomplete, or unknown when the record says neither

records.description: present instead of record when several matched; at most ten are listed

items.description: One index record, reduced to what a reader can act on.

coverage.description: null when the record was written before records carried a coverage block

verdict.description: clean, findings, incomplete, or unknown when the record says neither

title: Look up an MCP server's evidence
